citation.title: Machine learning-based plasma profile reconstruction in KSTAR
citation.authors: L. Jung, J. Kim, J. Kang
citation.venue: Journal of the Korean Physical Society

topic: Neural-network surrogate of EPED-parameterized MCMC profile fitting (Ne, Te, Ti) on KSTAR
own_question: Can a network map same-time TS/TCI/CES channel values and uncertainties to six EPED shape parameters, replacing slow MCMC fitting for between-shot analysis?
actual_method_and_evidence: Dense TensorFlow networks, with separate models per profile and per campaign (2020–2022). Targets are MCMC-fitted parameters, and profiles are rebuilt analytically. Preprocessing uses IQR outlier removal and linear interpolation. Evidence is a figure comparison with MCMC and range-normalized MAE of about 2–7% (Table 3). Table 2 reports training-fit metrics only. The paper reports about 12 min for MCMC versus under 5 s for ML per 5-s shot.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: On KSTAR, an ML surrogate of an EPED-constrained MCMC fit has been reported to reproduce MCMC Ne/Te/Ti profiles while reducing processing time from minutes to seconds.
claim_checks.qualification: Labels are MCMC fits, not independent truth. Inputs are concurrent diagnostic values, so this is offline between-shot analysis rather than temporal nowcasting. The method is H-mode only. Timing figures are the authors' own reports.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Changes in diagnostic channel count and position between KSTAR campaigns led these authors to train campaign-specific models.
claim_checks.qualification: This is the authors' rationale; no cross-campaign transfer was tested.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The input is same-time CES/TS values and errors, and the target is a fitted profile parameter set. There are no strictly past inputs and no BES/ECEI. Report arrival times are not measured. Ti is labelled as ion temperature without specifying impurity versus main ion.
validation_if_relevant: The paper states evaluation on unseen same-year shots, but the split, its size and any shot-level independence are not described. No untouched campaign is used.
forbidden_inferences: that this is current-report nowcasting or future prediction
that it was deployed in real time or used for control
that MCMC labels equal physical truth
that its Ti is main-ion Ti
that all prior KSTAR ML work is noncausal
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as a KSTAR-specific contrast. It is a fit-emulation surrogate driven by same-time diagnostics, which frames our causal temporal nowcast of a single CES report from strictly past information. It also documents campaign-dependent diagnostic configurations.
